comparison.objective: Candidate fractures and collects insert tangs; record flattens a curling poster under two weights.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision impact tooling and millimetre-scale fragment recovery; record requires drawing out compliant curled ends, holding tension, and placing weights bimanually.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four valid fractures, retained inserts, no damage, and tang containment; record requires both ends flat and weighted, release, and arm retreat. No specs add thresholds.
comparison.reason: Compliant sheet flattening under weights tests sustained tension and placement, not impact fracture or fragment handling.
